scripts.api:check: uv run --directory apps/api python -m compileall -q instalite_api
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @instalite/shared build && pnpm --filter @instalite/web build && pnpm --filter @instalite/electron build && pnpm api:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @instalite/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @instalite/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @instalite/electron typecheck && pnpm api:check
